newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indosat up on submarine cable deal.
newsitem.headline: Indosat up on submarine cable deal.

text.p: Shares in the state-controlled telecommunications giant PT Indonesian Satellite Corporation (Indosat) closed the morning session higher on Thursday after the signing of a $1.3 billion submarine cable deal, brokers said.
Indosat rose 150 rupiah to 6,975 rupiah on a volume of close to 1.2 million shares at the end of the morning session.
"We expect Indosat to be able to lower its operating costs in the longer-term by using the faster and higher capacity cable," one broker said.

A consortium of some 90 firms including Indosat signed an agreement in Singapore on Wednesday to build a 38,000 km (23,600 miles) network linking the South Pacific to the North Atlantic across Asia and the Middle East.

The network is the world's longest and has the largest capacity allowing fast, high quality links for services such as the internet and business communications. It is scheduled to open for commercial traffic by the end of 1998.
New York-listed shares of Indosat closed 5/8 higher at $29 overnight.
